stage: Stage 2D exploratory control with a matched return step
nature: Development experiment designed after the Stage 2B results, the Stage 2C post hoc analysis and its supplementary case reading were seen. Not a confirmatory test, not an independent validation, not a final Test.

repository.head: 7bb6b4d37accc52b5ce99b0fe5b7ccce3c6f4c50
repository.note: the code that runs is fixed by the per-file SHA256 below, not by the commit

policy.unchanged: weights, schedule, DDPM steps, action clip
policy.absolute_episode_time_in_the_policy_inpu: no: the policy reads RGB history and qpos/qvel/tcp_pose history (schema rgb_qpos_qvel_tcp_v1); t/horizon appears only in policy.features(), which the base policy does not use for acting

scenes.rule: first 12 seeds of splits/train in ascending order that are neither Stage 2A nor Stage 2B scenes and are declared for no other use; a seed whose initial cube placement equals a placement on record is replaced by the next train seed. Outcomes of this policy are never an input.
scenes.scene_identity: server step `scenes` (cube placement within 1e-05 m counts as identical); references: demonstrations, Stage 2A and Stage 2B scenes from stored keys, audit/dev/policy-evaluation scenes by reset; calibration and Test by seed only, never reset
scenes.shrink_rule: prefix of the list, chosen from measured time and cost of the first two scenes only
scenes.future_use: these scenes stay development data; they are never moved to calibration or Test
scenes.not_reused: Stage 2B scenes with favourable results (e.g. 10035, 10043) are not part of this sample

audit.use: engineering check of restore and of the new arms; not a performance sample and not a denominator
audit.protocol: Stage 2A audit (same compared items, same tolerances) + restore and trace after the R5 control-only reference, after R5, R2M and H0M + R5 control part against the reference + handoff step/seed/queue/history + exact check that saving the policy inputs changes nothing

continue.definition: existing Continue: queue and history kept, next inference at the natural chunk boundary, Runtime.force not called

retreat_5cm.definition: existing Retreat-Retry through Runtime.force(2), unchanged: target snapshot TCP + 0.05 m (z), command increment <= 0.005 m/step, arrival tolerance 0.005 m, at most 40 steps, last gripper command held

retreat_2cm_matched.definition: queue discarded once; feedback control towards snapshot TCP + 0.02 m (z) with the R5 controller, increment limit and tolerance; at the first step with the measured TCP within tolerance that measured position (p_arrival) becomes a fixed hold target; control ends after T_ref steps; if the target is not reached within T_ref steps the arm ends there with target_reached=false (no extra time, not excluded); then queue cleared and the policy resumes on the real history

hold_matched.definition: queue discarded once; the snapshot TCP position is a fixed hold target followed by the same delta controller for T_ref steps; physics runs normally (no set_state, nothing frozen); then queue cleared and the policy resumes on the real history

arms.common: gripper command of the snapshot held in every control step; every control step goes through Runtime.advance (real observation history, horizon charged); success_once_absorbing and horizon 200 unchanged; an arm that ends during control stops at once
arms.tolerance_note: the 5 mm arrival tolerance is not tightened for R2M; commanded distance and achieved displacement are recorded separately

t_ref.rule: per snapshot: restore, run the control part of R5 alone (Runtime.force(2), no policy inference), read retreat_info.steps_used after it ended and before the policy is called; restore and verify the full state and observation again
never: a value chosen after any branch outcome
t_ref.reference_must: call the policy 0 times; every R5 of that snapshot must reproduce the reference commands, states, observations and step count, otherwise the scene stops as a technical fault
t_ref.early_end: if the reference ends during control (success or termination) T_ref is its steps_used and reference_early_absorbing=true; the other arms still use that T_ref and stop at once if they end earlier; the matched-handoff check is N/A for such blocks; no block is removed
t_ref.accounting: the reference is preparation; it is recorded per snapshot and never counted as a continuation or an outcome
t_ref.caveat: T_ref is taken from the simulator response to R5. The matched arms could not be deployed as they are.

noise.seed_rule: seed_for(scene, physical_step_of_the_call, block_repeat_id, 'dp') for all four arms (unchanged code path)
noise.handoff: R5, R2M and H0M make their first inference at checkpoint + T_ref with the same seed unless the episode ended during control; their observations differ, so the action chunks are not required to be equal
noise.continue: C0 infers at other steps with other seeds; differences from C0 are not called a pure movement or time effect
noise.caveat: equal seeds specify the same pseudo-random condition; this is not a proof of statistical independence

reproducibility_checks.every_snapshot: continue with block repeat 0 must reproduce the never-restored trunk; the state is verified again after the T_ref reference
reproducibility_checks.every_block: R5 control part equals the reference; handoff of the three control arms
reproducibility_checks.first_two_scenes: after all other branches of a snapshot: R2M and H0M of repeat 0 once more
reproducibility_checks.on_mismatch: a wrong control part or handoff stops the scene; a rerun mismatch is flagged, never subtracted, and the data set is not marked complete

observation_fields.online_inputs_file: branches/inputs/<scene>.npz, arrays named t<checkpoint>_<field>; written once per snapshot before any continuation is run

online_inputs.rgb_history: uint8 [obs_horizon, H, W, 3 x cameras]; cameras in sorted name order, exactly what the policy receives
online_inputs.state_history: float32 [obs_horizon, D]; qpos, qvel, tcp_pose (the whitelist of src/hci/schema.py)
online_inputs.queue: float32 [n, 4]; unexecuted commands of the current chunk
online_inputs.policy_feature: float32; fixed encoder output of the frozen policy for the same history, + last action, t/horizon, queue fraction

diagnostic_privileged_only.scene JSON: initial_state, snapshots[].s: cube poses, grasp/on-cube/static flags, stage labels read from simulator ground truth
diagnostic_privileged_only.branches/traces/<scene>.npz: per-step TCP, cube positions, flags, success, executed action, gripper joint positions, phase; `ref_<checkpoint>` is the R5 control-only reference run

observation_fields.rule: Nothing of the diagnostic group is written into the online input file, given to the policy, or used for a control target. No model was trained in this stage.
observation_fields.online_proprioception_in_traces: gripper_qpos_1/2 are the last two entries of the qpos observation the policy already receives; logged per step to tell the gripper command from the finger position. They are not a new policy input.
observation_fields.controller_inputs_of_the_matched_arms: measured TCP position, the snapshot TCP position, the last gripper command, T_ref. No object pose, no task flag, no outcome.

events.denominator: all blocks whose cube was grasped at the checkpoint, for all four arms; blocks not grasped are listed separately
read: grasp flag kept through the control part
first open command (gripper action > 0) after the return (C0: after the checkpoint)
first grasp-flag release after the return
cubeA-cubeB horizontal distance, cube height and on-cube flag at those steps
events.missing: no open command / no release is a recorded value, never a dropped row
events.examples: chosen after the tables as the first scene/checkpoint/repeat in ascending order, and marked post hoc

video_rule: first two scenes, first usable checkpoint, block repeat 0, the four arms (at most 8 files); no outcome-selected example is added

analysis.unit: block (scene, checkpoint, block_repeat_id): the four 2x2 cells with numerator and denominator
analysis.primary_summary: scene-equal weighting: mean over reached checkpoints and repeats within a scene, then over scenes; block totals shown separately

budget.cost_basis: credit difference, not hourly price x time
budget.includes: install, transfer, audit, trunks, reference runs, reruns, backup
